previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (h~8-10, w~11-14) with: (a) ROW 0 — 1-4 NON-ZERO TRANSFORM CODES (values from {1, 2, 3, 4} where 1=IDENTITY, 2=ROT CW, 3=ROT 180, 4=ROT CCW, etc.) at distinct random columns; (b) ROW 1 — ALL 0 (separator); (c) ROWS 2..h-1 — a BASE MOTIF: a connected 3-5 cell blob in COLOR 8 or 9 (motif color), placed at random interior position. Rule (PACK TRANSFORMED COPIES OF THE BASE MOTIF, ONE PER ROW-0 CODE, LEFT-TO-RIGHT WITH 1-COL GAPS): identify the ROW-0 CODES (in column order) and the BASE MOTIF (crop to its bbox). For EACH CODE in row 0 (left to right): APPLY the code's transform to the base motif crop. PACK the transformed crops HORIZONTALLY with 1-COLUMN BG GAP between adjacent pieces. Output is the row of transformed copies. Net: each row-0 code spawns a transformed motif side-by-side.
